Seattle 37% to 66%, Ithaca +10 points, ESP memo (40+ pilots, nearly 60%) and PR Newswire claims are C, maybe from an unfetched page. Summary does include an advocacy-source caveat. Saint Paul and Cambridge numbers match the pages.
